incoming_learnings: Distinguish immobilization from impassable terrain before consuming route alternatives. A displayed one-turn root can be renewed by regrowth; use a finite, observed-clock-funded retirement transaction and recheck hazards each input. Retain mandatory pickup receipts and terminal exhaustion.

review.review: The hero was alive at 30/30 HP when planning stopped. The initiating problem was unresolved frost-room preparation, not death or a frozen clock. D356 (log 991) saw upgrade 311 and ate the floor's puzzle meal. D366 (logs 1020–1021) tested a silver singleton and observed invisibility, not fire removal. Golden potions x2 were honestly stashed and retrieved, but remained unidentified. Already at D386 (log 1082), before hunger returned, the remaining unprotected stack could not pass frost-test inventory protection. At D584 (logs 1616–1617), hunger also excluded testing, the meal was spent, and no intuition stone, identify scroll, protected potion bag or known frost remained. The mandatory upgrade remained excluded by the eternal-fire buffer; descent recovery correctly declined this mandatory blocker. An earlier piranha-room incident recovered through an accepted descent (log 756), leaving its chest deferred without collection credit. Complete source browsing resolved the omitted-controller gap. Independent reduced public-input probes reproduced preparation declining, but were not recovered runtime memory or full selector replay. No patch is supplied: ordinary DROP removes the entire stack, and no recorded safe identification or protection prerequisite supports a replacement action without relaxing safety. The unchanged Python suite passed 2437 tests, with four skipped; no red/green repair claim is made.
review.learnings: Plan mandatory room preparation across possible failed hypotheses, including protection or identification of the remaining potion stacks. A successful unknown test transaction is not puzzle completion. Keep mandatory pickup receipts, fire restrictions and terminal planner exhaustion; do not replace missing prerequisites with extra waiting or guessed potion identities.

Allowing its frost test would weaken existing collateral protection. Next, build a D356 multi-candidate prerequisite quote covering silver's possible nonfrost result, then establish an observed identification/protection acquisition and safe route before scheduling it. Any proposed single-dose separation needs public action and quantity receipts first; source inspection alone does not supply that capability.
